translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Israa'eeliyaa anjjiyaawe Med'inaa Godaa nashechcheeddawaa Balaami be'eedda wode, kase I ootseeddawaadan murunanaw koyibeenna; shin bare som"uwaa mela biittaakko zaareedda.
Yaatiide d'ok'k'u gi s'eelliide, Israa'eeliyaa Asay bare zariyaan zariyaan dunkkaani utteeddawaa be'eedda; S'oossaa Ayyaanay Aa bolla wod'd'eedda.
I bare timbbitiyaa hawaadan yaagiide odeedda;

content.text: Aa ayfii tishshi ootsi s'eelliyaawaa timbbitii,
Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaa sas'aa be'iyaawaa timbbitii hawaa.
unttunttu barenttu wonddaafiyaa zubbiyaan unttuntta c'addana.
Mac'c'a gaammattidan unttuntta dentsanaw ooni s'alanee?
hinttena shek'k'iyaa ubbay shek'etteeddawaa gidanawaa» yaageedda.

content: Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Baalaak'i Balaama bolla hank'k'uwaa ees's'i keseedda. Baalaak'i bare kushiyaa dukkiide Balaama, «Ta morkkatuwaa k'angganaadan taani neena s'eesaad; shin neeni ha heezzu gedekka unttuntta anjjaadda.
Simmi ha"i neeni ne golle bak'ata; ‹Taani new darobaa woytana› gaad; shin neeni woytuwaa akkenaadan Med'inaa Goday neena diggeedda» yaageedda.

‹Baalaak'i haray atto bare biraynne work'k'ay kumeedda bare kaatiyaa golliyaa taw immeeddawaa gidinttonne, Med'inaa Goday odeeddawaa aad'aadde, lo"uwaa woy iitaa ta sheniyaan ootsanaw danddaykke. Taani Med'inaa Goday giyaawaa s'alalaa gaana› yaagaade new odabeykkitayye?» yaageedda.
Yaagiide, «Taani ha"i ta asaakko bay; shin neeni haaya; ha Asay wurssetsa wodiyaan ne asaa ootsanawaa taani new odana» yaageedda.
I bare timbbitiyaa hawaadan yaagiide odeedda;

content.text: Aa ayfii tishshi ootsiide s'eelliyaawaa timbbitii,
Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaa sas'aa be'iyaawaa timbbitii hawaa.
Taani Aa be'ay; shin wodii ha"a gidenna;
taani Aa s'eellay; shin matan gidenna.
Moo'aaba asaa som"uwaa I gaac'c'i k'olana.
Seete asaa ubbaa huup'iyaa I kinchchana.
unttunttu kataman pas'a atteedawantta d'ayissana» yaageedda.

content: Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Balaami Amaaleek'a asatuwaa be'iide, bare timbbitiyaa hawaadan yaagiide odeedda:
K'ay Balaami K'eena asatuwaa be'iide, bare timbbitiyaa hawaadan yaagiide odeedda;
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Balaami bare timbbitiyaa hawaadan yaagiide odeedda;
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Balaami denddiide, bare golle simmeedda; Baalaak'ikka bare ogiyaa beedda.
